question: 'A' can complete 40% of a work in 6 days, while ‘B’ can complete the work in 7(1)/(2) days. If they work together, then in how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:-**

A can complete 40% of a work in 6days, and B can complete the work in 15/2

**Calculation:-**

A can complete 40% of a work in 6 days this means that= 40/100× 1/6= 1/15

B can complete work in 15/2 days then the efficiency will be= 2/15

⇒ (A + B)= (1)/(15) + (2)/(15)

⇒ (3)/(15)= (1)/(5)

⇒ 5 days.

Hence, Working together they can complete the work in= **5 days.**
